title: Goodwill Share by Recorded Exclusion: Calibration Workmanship Warranty Guidance
content:
**Guidance.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the calibration goodwill share on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty, being the share of the calibration diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before that the calibration goodwill takes, follows the exclusion recorded by the most recent inspection on the coverage that found a concern not covered:

| Exclusion recorded by the most recent not-covered inspection on the coverage | Calibration goodwill share |
|---|---|
| mileage exceeded | the boundary goodwill share, 0.10 (10 per cent) |
| term exceeded | the boundary goodwill share, 0.10 (10 per cent) |
| not a covered kind | the kind goodwill share, 0.07 (7 per cent) |
| any other exclusion | the standard goodwill share; no different share applies |

## Points of judgement

- **Which inspection.** The most recent inspection on the coverage that found a concern not covered, whichever concern it was; earlier not-covered inspections do not decide the share.
- **What is read.** The exclusion that inspection recorded.
- **Boundary exclusions.** Mileage exceeded and term exceeded both take the boundary goodwill share.

## Hypothetical illustrations

1. The latest not-covered inspection recorded mileage exceeded; with calibration diagnostic charges of USD 80.00 booked less than one whole month before, the share-based amount is 10 per cent of USD 80.00, USD 8.00.
2. The latest recorded not a covered kind; on the same charges the share-based amount is 7 per cent, USD 5.60.
3. The latest recorded new damage; the share remains the standard goodwill share.
